english.title: Goods vehicle - operator's licence - exceed maximum trailer weight

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: GOODS VEHICLES LICENSING OF OPERATORS ACT 1995

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the holder of an operator's licence which specified the use at any one time of a maximum number of trailers, whose relevant weight may be greater than the weight specified in the licence, exceeded that number in contravention of section 6(6) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(8) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
holder of operators licence

whose relevant weight greater than specified in licence
exceeded that number in contravention of section 6(6)

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was the holder of an operator's licence which specified the use at any one time of a maximum number of trailers, exceeded that number by using **(..SPECIFY NUMBER..) trailers at any one time.
